non_authority_statement: Candidate literary/form evidence only. No theology, canon, authorship, date, genre-historicity classification, miracle mechanism, identity, ethnic comparison, prayer source, divine psychology, relenting doctrine, ethics, sign or fulfillment, preferred witness, reading, translation, source tradition, graph, retrieval, promotion, or reviewed-gold authority.
routing_principle: Prefer complete commission-and-flight, storm-escalation, interrogation, casting-and-calm, fish-prayer-deliverance, recommission-and-compliance, proclamation, city-response, observed-turning response, anger-dialogue, appointed-agents object lesson, and final-dialogue movements. Repetition, irony, reversal, scene, speaker, poetic-form, action-response, and rhetorical-question markers are evidence only; retain larger narrative and prayer parents whenever a narrower seam is disputed.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: commission, counter-flight, storm, interrogation, casting, calm, and sailor response
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Repeated arise/go, descent, great, fear, sea, and perish language drives one escalating commission-response and storm-resolution scene.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: appointed-fish frame with embedded prayer and deliverance
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: The appointed fish, prayer introduction, complete descent-remembrance-vow poem, and expulsion form one enclosure; the prayer is not detached from its narrative frame.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: second commission, compliance, proclamation, civic response, decree, observed turning, and divine response
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: The repeated word-event initiates a tightly linked proclamation-response sequence whose brief seams remain nested in the chapter parent.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: anger prayer, question dialogue, city-side waiting, appointed-agents object lesson, and unanswered final question
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Repeated displeasure, anger, good, pity, and die language binds the two dialogues around the plant-worm-wind enactment and open rhetorical close.

global_hot_zones.issue: Commission and counter-flight invite historical, moral, or character-authority conclusions.
global_hot_zones.handling: Use repeated arise/go and directional contrast only; defer history, motive, morality, and identity.

global_hot_zones.issue: Narrative irony, sailor actions, divine titles, fear, sacrifice, and vows invite ethnic or spiritual-status comparison.
global_hot_zones.handling: Use escalation, dialogue, action, calm, and scene closure only; decide no conversion, superiority, miracle, or theology.

global_hot_zones.issue: Fish wording, three-days language, miracle questions, prayer diction, and Psalm-like correspondences invite source and fulfillment claims.
global_hot_zones.handling: Preserve the full parent; decide no mechanism, prayer source, dependence, sign, typology, or fulfillment.

global_hot_zones.issue: The prayer has credible descent, reversal, remembrance, contrast, and vow movements.
global_hot_zones.handling: Record internal movement evidence but retain the whole prayer in its enclosing parent rather than promoting stanza children.

global_hot_zones.issue: Nineveh's greatness and journey measures are translation- and history-sensitive.
global_hot_zones.handling: Use entry and proclamation as narrative evidence only; defer size, duration, geography, chronology, and historicity.

global_hot_zones.issue: The short proclamation, city response, decree, turning, and divine response can be atomized or made doctrinal.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep exact seams nested inside one chapter parent; decide no repentance doctrine, decree historicity, animal practice, or causation.

global_hot_zones.issue: Divine seeing and relenting language is lexically, translationally, and theologically charged.
global_hot_zones.handling: Treat it as narrated response and hinge; defer lexeme, divine psychology, immutability, causation, and doctrine.

global_hot_zones.issue: Jonah's anger prayer cites divine attributes and culminates in a terse question.
global_hot_zones.handling: Preserve speech and response together; decide no theology from the speech, narrator endorsement, motive, ethics, or divine psychology.

global_hot_zones.issue: Booth, plant, worm, wind, gladness, fainting, death wish, and renewed question create tempting micro-scenes.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep the appointed-agents sequence coherent; record 4:9-11 as the dialogue alternative.

global_hot_zones.issue: The final comparison, population expression, animals, pity, and unanswered question invite ethical and doctrinal closure.
global_hot_zones.handling: Preserve the complete final speech and open interrogative form; decide no arithmetic, ethics system, divine psychology, or doctrine.

anti_oversplit_guards.guard: Keep commission and mirrored counter-flight together.
Do not split wind, storm, mariners, cargo, sleep, waking, and call-to-prayer.
Keep lot, questions, self-identification, fear, and recognition together.
Keep proposed casting, failed rowing, appeal, casting, calm, fear, sacrifice, and vows together.
Do not detach the prayer from its fish enclosure or split each poetic image, contrast, vow, or deliverance response.
Keep popular response, royal response, decree, human-animal scope, turning, and expressed uncertainty together.
Keep anger, prayer, death wish, and answering question together.
Do not isolate booth, plant, worm, wind, fainting, renewed anger, comparison, animals, or final question from the closing parent.

units.title: Commission and counter-flight
units.literary_form: word-event commission and reversal-laden narrative response
units.deciding_marker: The word-event and arise/go commission are immediately answered by Jonah's mirrored arising to flee, repeated Tarshish destination, and repeated departure from Yahweh's presence.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 1:1, 1:1-2, or 1:3 when the commission and anti-response form the opening contrast.
units.risk: Authorship, date, identity, history, motive, morality, destination symbolism, and theology remain deferred.

units.title: Storm onset and the sleeping passenger awakened
units.literary_form: storm-escalation scene with action list, ironic contrast, and direct address
units.deciding_marker: The adversative divine wind begins a sea crisis; mariner fear and cargo action contrast with Jonah's descent and sleep until the captain's arise/call speech.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split the sailors' actions, Jonah's sleep, or the captain's summons from the storm onset.
units.risk: Miracle mechanism, irony classification, God/god translation, sailor spirituality, characterization, and ethnic comparison remain deferred.

units.title: Lot, interrogation, disclosure, and intensified fear
units.literary_form: investigative dialogue with question cluster, answer, recognition, and reaction
units.deciding_marker: A proposal to cast lots initiates a sustained interrogation; Jonah's answer and the sailors' recognition complete the question-disclosure-reaction movement.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize the lot, question list, self-identification, or reaction.
units.risk: Lot theology, guilt, confession, divine-title semantics, irony, sailor status, and identity claims remain deferred.

units.title: Casting deliberation, sea quiet, and sailor response
units.literary_form: crisis dialogue, attempted alternative, appeal, decisive action, sea resolution, and human coda
units.deciding_marker: The renewed storm prompts a what-shall-we-do exchange; proposal, failed rowing, appeal, casting, sudden calm, fear, sacrifice, and vows complete the crisis.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not end at the casting or detach the calm and sailor response.
units.risk: Culpability, innocent blood, divine causation, miracle, conversion or worship status, sacrifice, vows, and theology remain deferred.

units.title: Appointed fish, descent-and-remembrance prayer, vow, and deliverance
units.literary_form: narrative enclosure containing a lyric prayer of distress, descent, reversal, remembrance, contrast, thanksgiving, and vow
units.deciding_marker: The appointed fish creates the enclosure; prayer introduction yields to sustained poetic parallelism from cry and descent through remembered temple, contrast, vow, and acclamation, followed by expulsion.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach 1:17 or 2:10, and do not promote internal prayer stanzas as independent chunks in this larger-parent route.
units.risk: Fish wording, miracle mechanism, three-days language, prayer source, Psalm dependence, Sheol or pit referents, salvation doctrine, sign, typology, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Second commission and compliant journey
units.literary_form: repeated word-event commission with narrative response and scene-setting
units.deciding_marker: The explicit second-time word-event repeats arise/go/preach, now followed by Jonah's mirrored arising and going before city entry begins.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate the second commission from its immediate compliance or extend it through the distinct proclamation.
units.risk: Motive, character arc, history, city size or journey measure, chronology, translation, and theology remain deferred.

units.title: The brief proclamation
units.literary_form: entry notice and compressed public proclamation
units.deciding_marker: Jonah's entry culminates in a formally quoted proclamation whose forty-day and overturn language triggers the following response.
units.rejected_alternative: Prefer 3:4-9 as proclamation-and-response if the short seam oversplits; retain this LOW unit nested in 3:1-10.
units.risk: Chronology, overturn lexeme, prediction, conditionality, message completeness, history, source, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Citywide response, royal enactment, and decree
units.literary_form: cascading communal response with royal reversal, proclamation, imperative list, rationale, and open hope
units.deciding_marker: The people respond; the report reaches the king, whose actions and decree expand the fast, sackcloth, crying, and turning and end in a who-knows rationale.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split popular response, royal response, animal-inclusive decree, imperative list, or uncertainty.
units.risk: Belief or repentance doctrine, king identity, decree historicity, animal practice, fasting ethics, violence, causation, and divine psychology remain deferred.

units.title: Observed turning and narrated divine response
units.deciding_marker: The narrator reports divine seeing, the people's turning, and divine relenting as the response to 3:5-9 and the condition that provokes 4:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Prefer 3:5-10 or 3:1-10 if this hinge invites proof-texting; retain it only as a LOW action-response seam.
units.risk: Lexical meaning, translation, repentance causation, foreknowledge, immutability, divine psychology, harm or evil terminology, theology, and ethics remain deferred.

units.title: Jonah's anger prayer and the first answering question
units.literary_form: reaction, complaint-prayer, death wish, and terse dialogue response
units.deciding_marker: Jonah's displeasure opens a reaction scene; his prayer explains the flight and appeals for death, followed by a direct question that closes the exchange.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach the quoted attributes, death wish, or answering question from the complaint dialogue.
units.risk: Motive, moral status, narrator endorsement, attribute theology, relenting lexeme, divine psychology, death ethics, and satire remain deferred.

units.title: City-side waiting and the plant-worm-wind object lesson
units.literary_form: scene relocation, waiting tableau, and three-stage appointed-agents enactment
units.deciding_marker: Jonah exits, builds a booth, and waits; successive appointment formulas introduce plant, worm, and wind, moving from shade and gladness to exposure, fainting, and renewed death wish.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate the booth, plant, worm, wind, gladness, fainting, or death wish from the cumulative sequence.
units.risk: Plant identification, causation, miracle mechanism, weather, chronology, psychology, pedagogical purpose, ethics, and allegory remain deferred.

units.title: Second anger dialogue and the unanswered final question
units.literary_form: question-answer exchange, comparison argument, and open rhetorical close
units.deciding_marker: A renewed question about anger elicits Jonah's answer; the final speech contrasts his pity for the transient plant with the city and ends in an unanswered question.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 4:11 as a maxim or detach 4:10's comparison from the exchange that frames it.
units.risk: Pity terminology, moral status, population expression, child-capacity interpretation, animal function, divine psychology, ethics, theology, satire, and the intended answer remain deferred.
